I will sow the beans using seed I kept from last season because those seeds know this soil and I do not have money to buy new ones from the agro-dealer. Chemical fertilizer and sprays are too costly for me this year, but I will put down cow dung and household ash to feed the land as I have always done. We depend on the rains, so I will not irrigate; my children and I will do most of the work, though I may hire a few days of labor when the weeding is heavy.
